messages:
jordan: Heads up — deploybot flagged a runtime/SKD pin mismatch on canary. Seeing routing failures for some model groups. Anyone on call?

deploybot: Automated alert: pin-check failed for canary.
```
requested_runtime: runtime-v3.2.1
pinned_runtime: runtime-v3.1.0
affected_models: llama3q-small, llama3q-medium
error_rate: 4.2% (requests with KV cache errors)
cluster: canary-eu-1
```

emily: ugh, 4% is above our canary threshold (2%). This looks like a runtime kernel mismatch with newer attention kernels.

sam: is SDK change 2.7.0 involved? We shipped a shim last week that touches kv-cache serialization.

kai: yes — SDK 2.7.0 added a compact-kv serialization path. If runtime-v3.2.* switched kernel layout, that combo can blow up. I ran a quick compatibility probe locally and saw deserialization exceptions.

jordan: OK hold all unpins/unrolls for canary. Do not escalate to prod. @sre-oncall can you add a temporary routing rule to avoid routing new traffic to runtime-v3.2.1 for affected model groups?

sre-oncall: On it — applying routing override to keep canary on runtime-v3.1.0 for llama3q-* groups. ETA 2m.

emily: I ran a small repro:
```
request: chat.generate(model=llama3q-small, runtime=3.2.1, sdk=2.7.0)
error: KVCacheDeserError: unexpected field length
stack: .../runtime/kv_cache.cc:452
```
This lines up with the kernel/layout mismatch hypothesis.

sam: recommendation: pin canary to runtime-v3.1.0 (already pinned by deploybot?) and gate runtime-v3.2.x rollout until we ship an SDK shim or patch runtime.

matthew: I'll draft the rollback/release note snippet for customers and internal release channels. Suggest we include: root cause = runtime kernel layout change incompatible with SDK 2.7 compact-kv; mitigation = temporary canary pin + staged rollout after compat tests + SDK patch.

sre-oncall: Routing override applied. Can confirm canary traffic is back on runtime-v3.1.0 (verified by tracing headers).

deploybot: Status update: applied pin enforcement on canary-eu-1 for model-group llama3q-* -> enforced_runtime=runtime-v3.1.0.

jordan: Thanks all. Next actions: 1) emily/sam run extended compatibility test matrix (sdk 2.6/2.7 + runtime 3.1/3.2) and post results, 2) kai to prototype runtime shim/patch, 3) matthew to post an internal release note and a brief customer-facing advisory if we see any customer impact, 4) schedule a short postmortem after fix.

emily: I'll upload test matrix CSV to the release thread and tag this for follow-up.

matthew: Draft ready, will push to #announcements-distro for review.

jordan: Closing thread for now — keeping the canary pin until compatibility signoff. Will reopen if anything changes. :thumbsup:
